name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Two waves totalling 759 drones on 1 Nov hit energy sites; Ukraine strikes Russian plants
state: Ukraine's air force said Russia launched 433 drones overnight into 1 Nov and 326 more during the day, hitting energy sites in four regions and leaving hundreds of thousands of households without power. Russia said it downed 235 Ukrainian drones overnight; Kyiv said it hit a plant in Rostov region. A local truce around Oleshky ended; front lines changed little.
for_you: Travel to Ukraine is against FCDO advice. Energy and grain markets remain sensitive to the war.
